Everpure Inc.

Everpure surged by 11.15%, closing at $121.88. The stock hit an intraday high of $131.41 and a low of $113.51, with a 52-week high of $131.41 and a low of $64.80. In extended trading, the stock rose 1.33% to $123.50.
The company outlined its growth strategy at its
, focusing on areas like Core AI and hyperscale solutions. Everpure reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 outlook, indicating expansion beyond its core storage business.

The company reaffirmed fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of $5.03 billion-$5.07 billion, up 37%-38% year over year, and non-GAAP operating income of $940 million-$960 million. Everpure introduced fiscal 2028 guidance calling for $7 billion-$7.3 billion in revenue and $1.7 billion-$1.9 billion in non-GAAP operating income, while second-quarter sales of $1.186 billion and adjusted EPS of 70 cents had both topped analyst estimates.
Akamai Technologies Inc.

Akamai Technologies stock fell by 6.78%, closing at $110.41. The stock’s intraday high was $118, with a low of $110.31, and a 52-week high of $165.45 and a low of $70.82. In after-hours trading, the stock shot up 20.65% to $133.21.

Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US Inc.

Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US Inc. skyrocketed by 114.85%, closing at $4.92. The stock reached an intraday high of $8.74 and a low of $4.61, with a 52-week high of $59.70 and a low of $1.51. The stock rose 16.06% to $5.71 in the after-hours session.

Apimeds Pharmaceuticals’ subsidiary MindWave Innovations signed a 12-month agreement with Singapore-based AQUAE Holdings to develop, deploy and operate AQUAEChain, a blockchain platform for managing and trading insured ecosystem-conservation credits. MindWave will receive service fees plus a recurring 20% allocation of all issued and outstanding ALCI Credits, with an option for a five-year extension after the initial term.
Costco Wholesale Corp.
Costco Wholesale Corp. decreased by 0.91%, closing at $896.48. The stock’s intraday high was $909.43, with a low of $895.26, and a 52-week high of $1096.50 and a low of $844.06.

Costco reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $95.72 billion, up from $86.16 billion a year earlier and above the $94.86 billion analyst estimate, while EPS of $6.75 topped expectations of $6.52. Quarterly net sales rose 11.2% to $93.9 billion, while the company’s shares remained below key moving averages despite the earnings beat.
